brief.headline: Revenue and transactions fell 20.8% week over week, with the biggest funnel leak at Add to cart -> checkout.
executive_summary: Revenue was 47276 vs 59721 previous week, a -20.8% change, and transactions were 685 vs 865, a -20.8% change.
Sessions were 33411 vs 38729, -13.7%, and conversion rate was 1.64 vs 1.99, -17.6%.
Add to cart -> checkout was 48.49 vs 58.25, -16.7%, and is the biggest funnel leak.
Direct transactions were 65 vs 49, +32.7%, and direct revenue per session was 0.86 vs 0.67, +28.9%.

what_changed.title: Total revenue and transactions declined
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 47276 vs 59721, -20.8%; transactions were 685 vs 865, -20.8%.

what_changed.title: Cart-to-checkout step weakened
what_changed.detail: Add to cart -> checkout was 48.49 vs 58.25, -16.7%, and is the biggest funnel leak.

what_changed.title: Direct segment moved differently
what_changed.detail: Direct transactions were 65 vs 49, +32.7%, with gap_vs_total_pts 53.5; direct revenue per session was 0.86 vs 0.67, +28.9%, with gap_vs_total_pts 37.2.

what_changed.title: High-interest products did not convert
what_changed.detail: Android Large Trace Journal Black had 3401 views, 1420 adds to cart, and 0 purchase lines; Google F/C Long Sleeve Tee Ash had 6353 views, 2325 adds to cart, and 0 purchase lines.

likely_drivers: The total decline is likely consistent with fewer sessions and users: sessions 33411 vs 38729, -13.7%, and users 27421 vs 31498, -12.9%.
The conversion drop is likely consistent with the Add to cart -> checkout leak: 48.49 vs 58.25, -16.7%.
Direct traffic is likely a partial offset: direct transactions 65 vs 49, +32.7%, and direct revenue per session 0.86 vs 0.67, +28.9%.
Product performance may be contributing: Google Men's Tech Fleece Grey had revenue_delta -1226, and several high-interest products had 0 purchase lines.
risks: If the Add to cart -> checkout leak persists, users who add items may not complete purchases.
If high-interest products remain unconverted, product interest will not become revenue.
If returning purchasers continue to decline, revenue will rely more on new purchasers: returning_purchasers were 34 vs 57, -40.4%, and revenue_from_returning was 2514 vs 5877, -57.2%.

actions.action: Run a checkout friction review for the Add to cart -> checkout step, including checkout entry, shipping/payment options, and error states.
actions.why: The biggest funnel leak is at this step, and total revenue and transactions are down.
actions.evidence: Add to cart -> checkout was 48.49 vs 58.25, -16.7%, and is the biggest funnel leak.

actions.action: Review PDP content, price display, and product information for top decliners and high-interest low-conversion products.
actions.why: Some products have high interest but no purchases, and top decliners show large revenue declines.
actions.evidence: Google Men's Tech Fleece Grey had revenue_delta -1226 with 4791 views and 3 units; Android Large Trace Journal Black had 3401 views, 1420 adds to cart, and 0 purchase lines.

actions.action: Create a win-back flow for one-time lapsing and at-risk high-value customers.
actions.why: Returning revenue is down and these RFM segments show recent but lapsed purchase behavior.
actions.evidence: one_time_lapsing had 638 customers, revenue_to_date 42374, and avg_recency_days 39.2; at_risk_high_value had 16 customers, revenue_to_date 3469, and avg_recency_days 47.4.

data_caveats: This is Google's public obfuscated GA4 sample, not a real client.
No calendar events are provided, so seasonality is not explained.
Treat source breakdowns with caution: session-level source is available for 73.5% of sessions; source unusable_pct is 24.4, campaign unusable_pct is 17.4, and medium unusable_pct is 14.1.
